title: Contractibility modulo orientation-preserving isometries of unit-weight pseudocircle realization spaces of finite rank-three chirotopes
author: Michael Gene Dobbins
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.171
difficulty_reason: The cited topological representation and Kneser theorems do not produce a continuous deformation on the oriented realization quotient. The author builds continuous canonical coordinates, modifies Kneser's deformation to respect precomposition by isometries, and proves that cellwise conformal interpolation depends continuously on pseudocircle boundaries. These compatibility arguments make the final quotient contraction well defined on the fixed unit-weight finite chirotope subspace.
